result.reason: The clause grants Customer a 30-day convenience right but does not require a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees. It also permits Kubient to terminate at any time after the Initial Term on 90 days’ notice, including during a renewal term, rather than only at the end of a term. The added immediate termination rights are unnecessary to meet the T4C playbook, materially expand the revision, and use undefined or questionable triggers such as “Kubient’s payment default” and “brand-safety failure.”
